make_video.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A painted cosmic sunset over a sea of clouds: the towering column of nebula smoke in electric cyan, violet, hot magenta and fiery orange churns and billows slowly upward out of the blazing golden sunburst on the horizon, its charcoal-black storm-cloud edges curling outward and breaking into drifting embers. Thin glowing pink meteors streak diagonally down from the upper left one after another, a larger white meteor with a long cyan tail crosses the whole sky, and the small dark planet with a cyan rim drifts slowly across the starfield. Below, the teal clouds roll steadily toward the camera and the orange reflection ripples and shimmers in the still pools of water. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the sunburst, then tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed, following the nebula column into the stars.
overall_soundscape: A deep low wind hum sweeps across the cloud sea, soft airy whooshes and faint crackles follow each passing meteor, the large meteor tears past with a long rushing roar, and a slow rumble swells from the churning nebula.
non_diegetic_music: Slow synth pads over a soft sub-bass drone; a sparse high bell arpeggio enters at 00:05.000 at about 70 BPM, and a soft kick pulse joins at 00:10.000 as the volume rises toward the end.
make_video.name: cosmic_sky_vid15_v1
